faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: The platform primarily works online so data can be saved and synchronized safely. Selected POS capabilities can continue offline and sync when the connection returns, depending on the operation and business setup.
Yes. Data migration can be coordinated with the platform team based on the source and scope, with a data review before execution.
Yes. Eligible plans support branches, warehouses, roles and reporting in one workspace while keeping each business isolated.
The POS is designed for fast daily work, with invoices, shift closing and clear permission-aware reports.
The available trial period and offers are shown with each published plan in the admin catalog, so you can start with a clear view of the available option.
How do I choose the right plan?
Start with the branches, users, warehouses and capabilities you need. The pricing page shows each plan's live limits to make comparison clear.
Can I change or cancel my plan later?
Plan changes can be reviewed according to the plan terms and current billing period. Check your subscription details or contact the team before changing it.
Is my business data secure and isolated?
Server-side access controls and tenant isolation protect business data, while sensitive operations are scoped to the authorized tenant and branch.
Can I add users with different permissions?
Yes. You can manage team members and assign permissions by role, so each user only sees and performs what they need.
Is support available during setup and after signup?
Setup and data migration can be coordinated according to your business scope, and the platform team can help with operational questions when needed.
